Founder Flat Rate

$245 per accepted truck / week

Standard Flat Rate

$299 per accepted truck / week

Minimum three accepted trucks for a new post-closure enrollment without a preserved Founder seat.

Reefer service is dispatch coordination only. It does not include temperature monitoring, refrigeration-unit operation, or a temperature guarantee. Estimate weekly plan costs and load mileage with your own numbers.
